display.usage: h1, h2, hero display, itinerary titles

body.usage: body copy, h3+, all UI text, button labels

rules: Single family throughout — Inter (and its display variant). No serifs anywhere.
Display weights only ever 600 or 700. Body never above 600.
Hero headlines run at 5xl–6xl on desktop, 3xl–4xl on mobile. Tight tracking (-0.02em).
Body copy stays at base (16px). Long-form paragraphs use lg (18px) only on dedicated reading pages.
Drive times, costs, captions: sm (14px) in muted color.
All-caps used sparingly — eyebrow labels only, with +0.08em tracking.
Number-tabular variant for prices, durations, distances (font-feature: 'tnum').
